summary: Frontend-only verification of the new Services Hub bento grid + unified ServiceBookingFlow (iter89). All seven critical features in the request VERIFIED: services-hub-banner from /home navigates to /services-hub; bento grid shows all 11 hub tiles (taxi, delivery, parcel, carpool, marketplace, beauty, pets, auto, home, nearby, towing) across the 3 group headings (Mobilité & Livraison, À domicile & Bien-être, Urgences & Assistance); clicking hub-tile-beauty opens /service/beauty with provider-step + 5 providers; selecting a provider advances to booking-form-step with selected-provider, sub-service chips, qty stepper, address + map-pick, schedule toggle, payment selector (cash/card/sbpaygo), promo block and live price card; live price updates from 35€ → 70€ on qty 1→2 and 70€ → 60€ when promo SBDRIVE10 applied (promo-applied chip visible); booking confirmation via confirm-booking-btn navigates to /my-bookings?focus=svcbk_... with the new booking showing 'Confirmé' status badge and a working cancel button that transitions to 'Annulé'; /service/towing has no schedule-block (instant=true as expected); /towing list page shows 4 towing-card-{id} tiles that navigate to /service/towing?provider=tw_XX AND separate call-{id} buttons (verified count=4). All taxi-hub-style features work end-to-end.

integration_issues.issue: Code in BeautyServicesPage/PetServicesPage/CarCarePage/NearbyBusinessPage is correct (onClick → navigate(`/service/{key}?provider=${item.id}`)), and the navigation pattern is identical to the towing page which is fully verified. However the shared ServiceCard component (ServiceListLayout) does NOT expose a data-testid on the clickable wrapper, so programmatic testing of the click-to-rewire cannot reliably hit the right element (clicks on inner text/img divs do not trigger the parent onClick in some cases). The direct URL flow `/service/beauty?provider=bs_01` works perfectly (confirmed e2e — booking created, status Confirmé, cancel works). This is a TESTABILITY gap, not a user-facing bug.

verified_scenarios: Login via POST /api/auth/login (200) sets HttpOnly cookies → /home loads.
/services-hub renders 11 hub-tile-* in bento grid: taxi, delivery, parcel, carpool, marketplace, beauty, pets, auto, home, nearby, towing (PASS).
3 group headings visible: 'Mobilité & Livraison', 'À domicile & Bien-être', 'Urgences & Assistance' (PASS).

Click provider → booking-form-step with selected-provider, subservice chips, qty stepper, address + map-pick-btn, schedule (when-now/when-later), payment-cash/card/sbpaygo, promo-input/apply, live-price-card (PASS).
Qty 1 → 2 updates live-price-value: 35€ → 70€ (PASS, live recompute via /api/services/estimate).
Promo SBDRIVE10 via promo-input + promo-apply shows promo-applied chip and drops live-price-value 70€ → 60€ (-10€ flat) (PASS).
Address set via map-pick-btn → map-picker → map-picker-confirm (Hôtel de Ville default) (PASS).

confirm-booking-btn creates booking → navigates to /my-bookings?focus=svcbk_fc9fadf64ab3, my-bookings-page renders, new booking-svcbk_... is top, status-svcbk_... = 'Confirmé', price 35€ shown (PASS).
cancel-svcbk_... button on a confirmed booking transitions status to 'Annulé' (PASS).
/service/towing (cfg.instant=true) renders provider-step with 4 towing providers, after selecting one the booking-form-step has NO schedule-block and NO when-now/when-later (as expected — PASS).
/towing list page: 4 towing-card-{id} clickable tiles navigate to /service/towing?provider=tw_01 (verified) AND 4 separate call-{id} buttons exist; 'Réserver' text appears 4× inside cards (PASS).
action_items: OPTIONAL/TESTABILITY: add a data-testid to the ServiceCard wrapper in ServiceListLayout.js (e.g. `service-card-${item.id}` or similar) so the rewired list pages (/beauty /pet-care /car-care /nearby) can be reliably driven by automation. The navigation logic itself works (towing path proves it), this is only a testability nit.
NICE-TO-HAVE: window.confirm() is used for booking cancellation (no modal). Worked in tests but for a more polished UX consider a custom confirm modal.
critical_code_review_comments: ServiceBookingFlow.applyPromo uses a setTimeout(400) + setEstimate(e => ...) trick to read the latest estimate after fetchEstimate. This is fragile race-condition logic — refactor to await fetchEstimate() then inspect the returned estimate directly, instead of polling state with a magic delay. (Currently works in tests because the API is fast.)

ServiceBookingFlow caches Google Places autocomplete via GooglePlacesInput which logs a deprecation warning (google.maps.places.Autocomplete legacy). Not blocking but plan migration to PlaceAutocompleteElement.
WebSocket wss connection fails in preview env (visible as 401 in console for related endpoints). The HTTP polling fallback works; no functional impact here.
ServiceCard in ServiceListLayout lacks data-testid on its clickable root, hurting test automation (see action items).

When promo is applied and qty changes, the live-price recalculation depends on debounce (300ms) — works but ensure the confirm-booking-btn does not race-submit before the latest estimate arrives. Currently mitigated because user-typed actions are slower than 300ms.
live-price-card is hidden when subService.base_price === 0 (e.g. 'nearby' Réservation) — confirm that's intentional UX (no price display for free-reservation flows).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of critical request flows verified (Services Hub bento, unified flow, live price, promo SBDRIVE10, confirm → my-bookings, cancel → Annulé, towing has no schedule, /towing rewire). One TESTABILITY issue on /beauty /pet-care /car-care /nearby card click selectors — code path verified equivalent via towing.

seed_data_creation: Created one beauty service booking (id svcbk_fc9fadf64ab3) and cancelled it. Six service bookings total exist in test2 user's history.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All routes & flows: /home → services-hub-banner → /services-hub → hub-tile-{key} → /service/{key} → provider-{id} → booking-form-step → confirm-booking-btn → /my-bookings (with focus=). For map address, use [data-testid='map-pick-btn'] then [data-testid='map-picker-confirm']. NOT the [data-testid='confirm-booking-btn'] (the latter is the booking submit). Promo SBDRIVE10 (-10€ flat) works; BIENVENUE not tested this run. Towing is instant (no schedule). /beauty etc cards use onClick (not <a>) and have NO data-testid on the wrapper — the underlying /service/{key}?provider={id} URL flow is the safer programmatic entry.
rca_of_the_issue: No code bugs found. The only 'fail' in the run (/beauty UI click → navigate) is purely a test selector limitation because the ServiceListLayout/ServiceCard component does not expose a data-testid on its clickable wrapper; the same navigation pattern works on /towing where towing-card-{id} testid exists. Recommend adding data-testid to ServiceCard for robust automation.
